step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents the 'Grid' data platform at Majid Al Futtaim. At top left, MetaManager microservices run on EKS, storing discovered metadata (tables, schemas, APIs) in an ElasticSearch/Neo4j MetaStore (OpenSearch) and enforcing governance policies on the S3 Data Lake. In the center Data Lake area, Kafka (MSK) ingests 250 GB of data across 600 topics from Multiple Data Sources, streaming into S3 (~60 TB datalake). EMR handles analytical transformations bi-directionally with S3 Data Lake and connects with external Applications. Consumed analytical outputs flow from S3 into RDS and from EMR into Vertica, serving Data Analysts and Data Scientists (DA/DS).

graph.name: Majid Al Futtaim Data Grid Architecture
graph.notes: centralized enterprise data platform architecture supporting cross-business unit analytics and marketing automation.

nodes.name: EKS MetaManager
nodes.notes: Microservices architecture running MetaManager to abstract operational complexity and govern data.

nodes.name: ElasticSearch / Neo4j
nodes.notes: MetaStore combining document and graph databases to store schema, table, and API metadata.

nodes.name: Kafka
nodes.notes: Enterprise streaming platform managing 600 topics, 250 GB throughput, and 7 days retention.

nodes.name: S3 DataLake
nodes.notes: Centralized S3 data lake storing approximately 60 TB of enterprise data.

nodes.name: EMR
nodes.notes: Big data processing framework managing ETL and batch analytics into and out of the data lake.

nodes.name: RDS
nodes.notes: Relational database used for publishing analytics payloads and OLTP access.

nodes.name: Vertica
nodes.notes: Analytical column-store database target for high-performance querying.

nodes.name: Multiple Data Sources
nodes.notes: Heterogeneous operational databases across 14 countries and multiple business units.

nodes.name: Applications
nodes.notes: External systems and APIs producing and consuming operational events.

nodes.name: DA/DS
nodes.notes: Data Analysts and Data Scientists consuming analytics outputs for ML models and dashboards.

edges.notes: MetaManager stores discovered metadata in ElasticSearch/Neo4j MetaStore.
MetaManager enforces data protection and governance policies over S3 Data Lake.
Data from multiple operational databases streams into Kafka.
Kafka sends real-time events back to external data sources.
Kafka streams ingested data into S3 Data Lake.
External applications exchange data with EMR analytics engine.
EMR delivers processed data back to business applications.
EMR reads raw data from S3 Data Lake.
EMR writes processed dataset results back to S3 Data Lake.
Data Lake publishes structured datasets into RDS.
EMR loads aggregated analytical datasets into Vertica.
